## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*Hetuduka, Vedanāttika* (Patthana 15.2) is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna* within the Abhidhamma Piṭaka. Structurally, it treats the analytical matrix formed by combining the "root dyad" (*hetuduka*) with the "feeling triad" (*vedanāttika*) [Nyanatiloka 2007]. In his structural analysis of the *Paṭṭhāna*, Nyanatiloka notes that this section follows the combination of the root dyad with the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*), demonstrating the exhaustive combinatorial methodology whereby the first dyad (*hetu*, etc.) is linked sequentially across all twenty-two triads, a process repeated across all one hundred dyads to generate the extensive matrix of dyad-triad chapters [Nyanatiloka 2007].
